exposure: Maternal race/ethnicity (Non-Hispanic Black women vs. Non-Hispanic white women)
Hospital Black-serving level (low-, medium-, high Black-serving hospitals)
cohort: The study included a cohort of 407,808 women in Washington State using linked birth-hospital discharge data.
finding: The risk of severe maternal morbidity was higher among Black women and in high Black-serving hospitals, even after adjusting for demographics and hospital Black-serving level.
